description: Implementation of a fake in-memory ContentRepository used for testing purposes; provides hardcoded data for content items and TV channels, simulating network calls via coroutine delay.

classes.name: FakeContentRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of ContentRepository that provides static data for testing.

methods.name: getContinueWatching
methods.description: Returns a list of ContentItem objects representing items the user is currently watching, after a simulated network delay.

methods.name: getTvChannels
methods.description: Returns a list of TvChannel objects representing available TV channels, after a simulated network delay.
